# meshoptimizer

Mesh optimization library by Arseny Kapoulkine, MIT licensed (`LICENSE.md`).
https://github.com/zeux/meshoptimizer

Vendored: version 1.1 (`MESHOPTIMIZER_VERSION 1010`), upstream commit
`8b9534ab47b6043c5add4ad0c852a0fc84c2597e`, `src/` only. Compiled into Core (no PCH) by
`Core/premake5.lua`. Used by `MeshSource::BuildRenderGeometry` (`Renderer/Mesh.cpp`) to build LODs.
